signals.text: Revenue grew 97% a year over 3 years vs 94% over 5: growth is accelerating.
Operating margin expanded 1933 bps in 3 years (-17.1% → 2.2%).
Working-capital days shortened by 177 days in 3 years (200 → 23).
Free cash flow was negative in 4 of the last 5 years: capex is running ahead of cash generation.

calls.tone: Committed to sustainable growth, operational efficiency, and disciplined risk management across digital marketplaces.
